text.tspan: 1. Accepts 12-24 V DC (either polarity) or 12-24 V AC. 230 V sites: feed J1 from a sealed 12 V AC/DC module.
2. XL7015 must be the 80 V (or 100 V) version: 24 V AC rectifies to ~34-37 V; the SMBJ40A clamps surges at ~65 V.
3. Vout = 1.25 V x (1 + R1/R2) = 5.04 V. Keep the SW / D3 / L1 / C3 loop short; C2 right at U1 pin 1.
4. Use 105 C electrolytics (C1, C3): the box gets hot in sunlight.
